headline: I'm Luiz. I build software: From Backend Infrastructure to Rendering Engines and Games.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer from Brazil, currently doing a Games Engineering master's at the University of Warwick. I've spent the last years building backend infrastructure, developer tools and real-time systems. And lately, graphics engines and games from the ground up.
This site collects what I've been working on. Check out my projects, have a look at my curriculum, or just reach out ;) I'm always open to new ideas, collaborations and feedback.
